fix_commit_message:
Fix incorrect buffer size computation for the base64() extension function. [forum:/forumpost/b1993c858f|Forum post b1993c858f].

FossilOrigin-Name: 603efcd404f0013559ca5bd936fc39481a3aa33a10340bac27b751b6b286d0b7
agent_reasoning: The bug-introducing commit added the base64()/base85() extension. Its buffer-size formula `4*(nv+2/3)` for the base64 encode path evaluates `2/3` first (integer division => 0), so it effectively computes `4*nv`, under-allocating the destination buffer versus the correct `4*ceil(nv/3)` quads needed, causing a heap buffer overflow for base64-encoding of blobs. The fix commit corrects this by parenthesizing the expression as `4*((nv+2)/3)` and widens the `nc` variable to `sqlite3_int64` to avoid overflow of the size calculation for very large inputs. I applied the equivalent edits directly to ext/misc/base64.c (adapting to the slightly different variable/macro names present at this intro commit, e.g. `ubyte`/`DARK_MAX`), without touching test files or other unrelated code.
